class.name: DesktopCaster
class.brief_description: Captures the primary display in real-time as a texture.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts desktop capture on a background thread. Automatically detects primary display size. Returns [code]true[/code] on success. If capture is already running, returns [code]true[/code] immediately. On failure the error message is accessible via [method get_last_error] and also printed to the Godot output panel. [codeblock] if not caster.start(): print(caster.get_last_error()) [/codeblock]

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops desktop capture and joins the background thread. Called automatically when the node exits the scene tree. Safe to call even if capture is not running.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the live [ImageTexture] updated each frame by the capture thread. Assign this once to a [TextureRect] — no need to reassign every frame, because the texture is updated in-place. [codeblock] func _ready(): caster.start() $TextureRect.texture = caster.get_texture() [/codeblock] Returns [code]null[/code] if [method start] has not been called yet.

method.name: is_capturing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the capture thread is currently running.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last error message reported by the capture thread, or an empty string if no error has occurred since [method start] was called.

method.name: set_fps_mode_runtime
method.description: Changes the [enum FpsMode] while capture is already running. The change takes effect immediately without restarting the capture thread. [codeblock] caster.set_fps_mode_runtime(DesktopCaster.FpsMode.VSYNC) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_target_fps_runtime
method.description: Changes the target frame rate while capture is already running. Only meaningful when [member fps_mode] is [constant FpsMode.MANUAL]. Values outside the range [code]1..240[/code] are clamped to [code]30[/code] to prevent a busy-polling loop.

members.member: Controls how the capture rate is determined. Use [constant FpsMode.MANUAL] to set a fixed FPS, or [constant FpsMode.VSYNC] to sync with the OS compositor.
Target frame rate when [member fps_mode] is [constant FpsMode.MANUAL]. Values outside [code]1..240[/code] are clamped to [code]30[/code].

constants.constant: Capture at a user-selected rate (see [member target_fps]). The default is 30 FPS.
Capture every time the OS compositor presents a new frame. Gives the smoothest result but may produce more frames than Godot can display.
